name: entangledvpn-electron
description: Entangled VPN — Electron shell (Linux primary; Windows optional)

scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ../client/frontend install && bash -c 'cd ../client/frontend && npx vite build --base=./ --outDir ../../electron/ui-dist --emptyOutDir'
scripts.build: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build:ui
scripts.start: bash scripts/ensure-electron.sh && npm run build:sidecar && electron .
scripts.dev: bash scripts/ensure-electron.sh && npm run build:sidecar && electron . --dev
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage dir
scripts.pack:win: npm run build:ui && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 npm run build:sidecar && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.pack:win:dir: npm run build:ui && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 npm run build:sidecar && electron-builder --win dir --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false

linux.synopsis: Mesh VPN for small friend groups

desktop.Name: Entangled VPN
desktop.Comment: Mesh VPN for small friend groups
